checked.claim: STP structure: 10 fields, 250 questions, one attempt, positive at 6 of 10 fields with 60% each
checked.official_value: Fields and counts match (30/30/30, 25 x4, 20 x3 = 250). 60% per field. One attempt only. Result: 6 or more fields positive means exams only for the failed fields (plus possible thesis); 5 or fewer means regular-curriculum exams (plus possible thesis). The test is not an exam under the UG, it is part of the investigation. The documents state field counts; the figure 250 is from the Wien 2023 info sheet.
checked.source: MedUni Wien Merkblatt Nostrifizierung Humanmedizin, version 1 Sep 2026 (read 10 Oct 2026); i-med.ac.at Termine Stichprobentest 2026 PDF (read 10 Oct 2026; same text as archive file document-5769604481259936460)
checked.fix: None. Add that the STP can be taken only once and that Wien expects the candidate to sit the next possible sitting after filing.

checked.claim: Pharma and Gerichtsmedizin attempts and no-show rule (attempts 4 and 5 commission, 3-month block)
checked.official_value: Registration forms: attempts 1 to 3 normal, attempt 4 and 5 commission. Merkblatt: failed exams may be repeated four times (5 attempts), a 6th for the last exam of the programme. Not deregistering at least 3 working days before (illness until exam day) triggers a statutory 3-month block.
checked.source: MedUni Wien Merkblatt Nostrifizierung Humanmedizin, version 1 Sep 2026 (read 10 Oct 2026); MedUni Wien Rezeptierkunde and Gerichtsmedizin registration forms (version 1 Mar 2023); MedUni Wien Pruefungskalender Rigorosumspruefungen WS2026/27 and SS2026 for Nostrifikanten (Gerichtsmedizin, Rezeptierkunde), read 10 Oct 2026

checked.claim: German C1 certificate is required with the application at Wien, Graz and Innsbruck
checked.our_value: SoT has no language rule. Blog says Vienna requires C1.
checked.official_value: Wien: C1 declaration plus a C1 certificate at filing, language exam taken no more than 3 years before the date of the exam it counts for, as the Merkblatt words it (Merkblatt 1 Sep 2026; Ermittlungsverfahren page). Graz web page: C1, certificate not older than 2 years. Innsbruck Nostrifizierungsablauf page: C1. Insufficient German does not change the STP result; language dictionaries are allowed, medical and electronic ones are not (Wien).
checked.source: MedUni Wien Merkblatt Nostrifizierung Humanmedizin, version 1 Sep 2026 (read 10 Oct 2026); meduniwien.ac.at Ermittlungsverfahren page; medunigraz.at Nostrifizierung page; i-med.ac.at Nostrifizierungsablauf page (all read 10 Oct 2026)
checked.fix: Add a language row to SoT: C1 certificate required at filing at all three; age limits 3 years (Wien, Merkblatt wording) and 2 years (Graz). Start date of the C1 rule (archive says Feb 2025) not verified.

checked.claim: Accepted certificates; a course certificate or German FSP is not enough
checked.official_value: Wien list (10 items): OESD C1, Goethe C1, telc C1 variants, DSD II, TestDaF level 4 and 5, OeIF C1, university language centre C1, DSH 2 or 3, German-language school-leaving certificate, or at least 3 years of study in German. The OeAK Fachsprachpruefung is not on the list. A course attendance certificate is not on the list.
checked.source: MedUni Wien Merkblatt Nostrifizierung Humanmedizin, version 1 Sep 2026 (read 10 Oct 2026)
checked.fix: Add the list or a pointer to the Merkblatt. Say 'FSP does not replace the C1 certificate' only as 'not on the Wien list'.

checked.claim: Stichprobentest is one joint test by Wien, Graz, Innsbruck; JKU hosts no sitting; venue rotates
checked.official_value: Joint since 2017 by the Austrian medical universities. Sittings rotate Innsbruck, Wien, Graz. Innsbruck page: the test can be taken anywhere, the result counts at the university where the application was filed. Registration is at the filing university.
checked.source: i-med.ac.at Termine Stichprobentest 2026 PDF (read 10 Oct 2026; same text as archive file document-5769604481259936460); i-med.ac.at Termine Stichprobentest 2027 PDF (read 10 Oct 2026, file dated 27 Aug 2026); i-med.ac.at Nostrifizierungsablauf page
